title: FDA Approved Neuralink's First Pivotal Trial

sentences.text: The FDA just approved Neuralink's first pivotal trial.
sentences.caption: First pivotal trial

sentences.text: Neuralink announced it on November twenty-fifth.
sentences.caption: Announced November 25

sentences.text: LINK is the first pivotal brain-implant trial in the United States.
sentences.caption: First brain-implant trial

sentences.text: It is for adults with severe paralysis from ALS.
sentences.caption: Severe paralysis from ALS

sentences.text: It tests cursor control, typing, and apps by thought.
sentences.caption: Cursor, typing, and apps

sentences.text: More than thirty people are already implanted.
sentences.caption: More than 30 implanted

sentences.text: Enrollment is open, and it costs nothing.
sentences.caption: Open, and it costs nothing

sentences.text: Travel and lodging for study visits are supported.
sentences.caption: Travel and lodging supported
